module TopModule(input clk, input reset, output reg shift_ena);
  reg [2:0] state;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
      state <= 3;
      shift_ena <= 1;
    end else begin
      case (state)
        0: begin shift_ena <= 1; state <= 1; end
        1: begin shift_ena <= 1; state <= 2; end
        2: begin shift_ena <= 1; state <= 3; end
        3: begin shift_ena <= 1; state <= 0; end
        default: state <= 0;
      endcase
    end
  end
endmodule
